design.actor_room_policy: one distinct actor and room per task
design.comparison_order: mirrored crossover; within each workload each width pair has ABBA or BAAB order
design.tail_limit: for n=10 p95 and p99 equal the maximum; no stable tail estimate

scope.wall_ms: Node spawn through exit and reap, including observer poll delay
scope.cpu_seconds: Linux wait4 whole-lifetime Node user plus system CPU
scope.peak_rss_bytes: Linux wait4 whole-lifetime high-water RSS of the one Node process
scope.observer_scheduling_delay: host scheduling delay may be added beyond the configured poll interval
scope.cpu_workload: synchronous integer work on one event loop; width does not add CPU workers
scope.throughput_scope: 16 Tasks divided by workload_wall_ms; excludes Node startup and exit

limits: snapshots can miss brief external work
observation selector is not a product SLO or adoption gate

observer_diagnostic.scope: harness self CPU during arms/postflight; excludes CLI Python observers and Node targets
observer_diagnostic.rss_scope: harness lifetime through this point; excludes final report serialization and exit
observer_diagnostic.harness_cpu_counter_limit: before/after self-rusage counters were not retained; only their observed delta is stored
observer_diagnostic.outside_node_attribution: includes observer/harness/service activity; not an exact total-observer counter

result_equivalence.fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON; sort_keys=true, ensure_ascii=false, separators=(comma,colon)
result_equivalence.result_digest_value: array of {index, value} objects reconstructed from each attempt rows

omitted: process identifiers and process command lines
